environment.description: EKS pod deployed in private subnet 10.0.7.0/24 within vpc-0xb7c4d9e2. Subnet route table rtb-0e7b4a has local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a blackhole route for 0.0.0.0/0 (status: blackhole) due to a previously deleted NAT gateway reference that was never cleaned up. Security group sg-0f4a8b2c allows egress only to 10.0.0.0/16 on ports 9092-9094 (Kafka) and 443 (internal services). No VPC peering or transit gateway attachments exist for this VPC.
